// taipei-trip.typ — 台北之旅 · June 2-8, 2026
// Professional Travel Magazine Edition
// Typst 0.11+ compatible syntax

// ─── COLOR CONSTANTS ────────────────────────────────────────
#let C-navy  = rgb("#0a1628")
#let C-coral = rgb("#e63946")
#let C-gold  = rgb("#f4a261")
#let C-teal  = rgb("#2a9d8f")
#let C-green = rgb("#52b788")
#let C-muted = rgb("#8d99ae")
#let C-light = rgb("#f4f4f4")
#let C-white = rgb("#ffffff")
#let C-text  = rgb("#1a1a2e")
#let C-warm  = rgb("#f7ede2")

// ─── HELPER FUNCTIONS ───────────────────────────────────────

// bullet-item helper — creates a bullet point with custom styling
#let bullet-item(txt) = {
  h(8pt)
  box(fill: C-muted, radius: 50%, width: 5pt, height: 5pt)
  h(4pt)
  txt
}

// chip / info badge — small label-value pair
#let chip(label: "", val: "", accent: C-teal) = box(
  radius: 4pt,
  inset: (x: 6pt, y: 2.5pt),
  fill: accent.lighten(90%),
)[
  #text(size: 7.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#label]
  #h(2pt)
  #text(size: 7.5pt, fill: C-text)[#val]
]

// schedule-table — creates a styled schedule with time/schedule rows
#let schedule-table(accent: C-teal, rows: ()) = {
  table(
    columns: (1.3cm, 1fr),
    inset: (x: 5pt, y: 4.5pt),
    stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 { none } else { 0.3pt },
    fill: (x, y) => if y == 0 {
      accent.lighten(25%)
    } else if calc.even(y) { C-light } else { C-white },
    align: (left, left),
    text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[TIME], text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[SCHEDULE],
    ..rows.map(r => (
      text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#r.at(0)],
      text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[#r.at(1)],
    )).flatten()
  )
}

// day-entry — single row for table of contents
#let day-entry(num: "01", day-color: C-teal, label-en: "", label-zh: "", subtitle: "") = {
  let row = grid(
    columns: (0.35cm, 2.5cm, 1fr, 2.5cm),
    column-gutter: 8pt,
    align: (center, left, left, right),
    box(width: 0.25cm, height: 0.9cm, fill: day-color, radius: 2pt),
    text(size: 11pt, weight: 900, fill: day-color)[#num],
    [
      #text(size: 10pt, weight: 800, fill: C-navy)[#label-en]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 10pt, weight: 600, fill: C-muted)[#label-zh]
    ],
    text(size: 9pt, fill: C-muted)[#subtitle],
  );
  let sep = v(6pt) + box(width: 100%, height: 0.5pt, fill: C-muted.lighten(60%)) + v(6pt);
  row + sep
}

// day-page template — full-bleed hero with two-column body
#let day-page(
  num: "01",
  date: "Monday, June 2",
  title-zh: "",
  title-en: "",
  subtitle: "",
  accent-color: C-teal,
  image-path: "images/yangmingshan.jpg",
  body-left: [],
  body-right: [],
  image-height: 7.5cm,
  star: false,
  gallery: none,
) = {
  page(paper: "a4", margin: (top: 0pt, bottom: 0pt, x: 0pt))[
    // Full-bleed hero image
    #box(clip: true, width: 100%, height: image-height)[
      #image(image-path, width: 100%, height: image-height, fit: "cover")
    ]

    // Gradient fade
    #box(width: 100%, height: 0.8cm, fill: gradient.linear(
      (C-navy, 0%),
      (C-navy, 100%),
      angle: 270deg,
    ))

    // Content area
    #box(fill: C-white, width: 100%, inset: (x: 1.8cm, top: 0.5cm, bottom: 1.4cm))[
      // Header
      #grid(
        columns: (1fr, auto, auto),
        column-gutter: 8pt,
        align: (left, left, right),
        [
          #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: accent-color, tracking: 3pt)[
            #box(width: 0.4cm, height: 0.5cm, fill: accent-color, radius: 2pt)
            #h(4pt)
            DAY #num
          ]
          #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-muted, tracking: 1pt)[#date]
        ],
        if star [
          #box(radius: 4pt, inset: (x: 8pt, y: 3pt), fill: C-gold)[
            #text(size: 8pt, weight: 700, fill: C-navy)[STAR ATTRACTION]
          ]
        ],
        [],
      )
      #v(2pt)

      // Title
      #text(size: 24pt, weight: 900, fill: C-navy, font: "Arial")[#title-zh]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 10pt, weight: 500, fill: C-muted, tracking: 1pt)[#title-en]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: C-muted)[#subtitle]

      #v(8pt)
      #box(width: 100%, height: 1.5pt, fill: accent-color)
      #v(10pt)

      // Two-column body
      #grid(
        columns: (38%, 62%),
        column-gutter: 14pt,
        align: (top, top),
        body-left,
        body-right,
      )

      // Inline facility gallery (if provided)
      #if gallery != none [
        #v(10pt)
        #box(width: 100%, height: 1pt, fill: accent-color.lighten(60%))
        #v(6pt)
        #text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent-color, tracking: 2pt)[FACILITIES & ATTRACTIONS]
        #v(4pt)
        #gallery
      ]
    ]
  ]
}

// gallery — inline 2–3 image grid with labels (for facility/attraction close-ups)
// images: list of (url-or-path, caption) pairs; cols: 2 or 3
#let day-gallery(images: (), cols: 3, accent: C-teal) = {
  let n = images.len()
  let img-w = if cols == 3 { 5.7cm } else { 8.7cm }
  let img-h = if cols == 3 { 3.5cm } else { 5.2cm }
  let gap = 5pt

  let cells = images.map(pair => {
    let (src, label) = pair
    box([
      #box(clip: true, width: img-w, height: img-h)[
        #image(src, width: img-w, height: img-h, fit: "cover")
      ]
      #v(2pt)
      #align(center)[#text(size: 6.5pt, fill: C-muted)[#label]]
    ])
  })

  if cols == 3 and n == 2 {
    h(1fr)
    cells.at(0)
    h(gap)
    cells.at(1)
    h(1fr)
  } else if cols == 3 and n == 3 {
    cells.at(0)
    h(gap)
    cells.at(1)
    h(gap)
    cells.at(2)
  } else if cols == 2 and n == 2 {
    cells.at(0)
    h(gap)
    cells.at(1)
  } else if n == 1 {
    h(1fr)
    cells.at(0)
    h(1fr)
  }
}

#let schedule-table(accent: C-teal, rows: ()) = {

    inset: (x: 5pt, y: 4.5pt),

// taipei-trip-zh.typ — 台北之旅 · 2026年6月2-8日

#let C-navy  = rgb("#0a1628")

#let bullet-item(txt) = {
  h(8pt)
  box(fill: C-muted, radius: 50%, width: 5pt, height: 5pt)
  h(4pt)
  txt
}

#let chip(label: "", val: "", accent: C-teal) = box(

)[

}

#let day-gallery(images: (), cols: 3, accent: C-teal) = {
  let n = images.len()
  let img-w = if cols == 3 { 5.7cm } else { 8.7cm }
  let img-h = if cols == 3 { 3.5cm } else { 5.2cm }
  let gap = 5pt
  let cells = images.map(pair => {
    let (src, label) = pair
    box([
      #box(clip: true, width: img-w, height: img-h)[
        #image(src, width: img-w, height: img-h, fit: "cover")
      ]
      #v(2pt)
      #align(center)[#text(size: 6.5pt, fill: C-muted)[#label]]
    ])
  })
  if cols == 3 and n == 2 {
    h(1fr)
    cells.at(0)
    h(gap)
    cells.at(1)
    h(1fr)
  } else if cols == 3 and n == 3 {
    cells.at(0)
    h(gap)
    cells.at(1)
    h(gap)
    cells.at(2)
  } else if cols == 2 and n == 2 {
    cells.at(0)
    h(gap)
    cells.at(1)
  } else if n == 1 {
    h(1fr)
    cells.at(0)
    h(1fr)
  }
}

# Replace gallery: gallery-magazine(accent: X, img1:..., img2:..., img3:...) with positional items
def convert_gallery(m):
    lines = m.group(0).split('\n')
    accent = ''
    items = []
    for line in lines:
        if 'accent:' in line and not items:
            accent = line.strip()
        for n in ['1', '2', '3']:
            mi = re.search(r'img' + n + r':\s*"([^"]*)"', line)
            mt = re.search(r'title' + n + r':\s*"([^"]*)"', line)
            md = re.search(r'desc' + n + r':\s*"([^"]*)"', line)
            if mi:
                items.append((mi.group(1), mt.group(1) if mt else '', md.group(1) if md else ''))
    
    result = '  gallery: gallery-magazine(\n'
    for img, title, copy in items:
        result += '    (img: "%s", title: "%s", copy: "%s"),\n' % (img, title, copy)
    result += '    ' + accent + ',\n  ),\n)'
    return result

pattern = r'  gallery: gallery-magazine\(\n.*?  \),\n\)'
content = re.sub(pattern, convert_gallery, content, flags=re.DOTALL)

# Convert "body-left: schedule-table(...\n...)),\nbody-right: [...\n...],\n" to "body: [\n#grid(...\nschedule-table,...\nbody-right-content,\n)]\n"

# Process day-page calls by finding body-left/body-right sections
def convert_day_body(m):
    block = m.group(0)
    
    # Extract body-left schedule table
    left_match = re.search(r'body-left: schedule-table\([^)]+\)\)\)', block, flags=re.DOTALL)
    # Extract body-right content
    right_match = re.search(r'body-right: \[(.*?)\],\n', block, flags=re.DOTALL)
    
    if not left_match or not right_match:
        return block
    
    left_content = left_match.group(0)
    right_content = right_match.group(1)
    
    # Remove body-left and body-right lines
    result = re.sub(r'body-left: schedule-table[^\n]*?\)\)\n', '', block)
    result = re.sub(r'body-right: \[[^\]]*?\],\n', '', result, flags=re.DOTALL)
    
    # Insert new body: block
    # Extract schedule table params (everything between "schedule-table(" and the closing "))"
    st_params = re.search(r'schedule-table\(([^)]+\)\)', left_content, flags=re.DOTALL)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import sys
import re
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

path = "/Users/sinchunyeung/Documents/Documents - SinMacBookPro/trip/Taipei/taipei-trip-en.typ"
with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = f.read()

# Pattern to match gallery-magazine calls
# img: "path", title: "Title", desc: "Desc"
pattern = re.compile(
    r'gallery: gallery-magazine\(\s*\n\s*accent: (\S+),\s*\n\s*'
    r'img1: "([^"]*)", title1: "([^"]*)", desc1: "([^"]*)",\s*\n\s*'
    r'img2: "([^"]*)", title2: "([^"]*)", desc2: "([^"]*)",\s*\n\s*'
    r'img3: "([^"]*)", title3: "([^"]*)", desc3: "([^"]*)",\s*\n\s*'
    r'\)',
    re.MULTILINE
)

replacements = 0

def replacer(m):
    global replacements
    accent = m.group(1)
    img1, title1, desc1 = m.group(2), m.group(3), m.group(4)
    img2, title2, desc2 = m.group(5), m.group(6), m.group(7)
    img3, title3, desc3 = m.group(8), m.group(9), m.group(10)

    # Convert em dashes inside descriptions to literal \u2014 for Typst
    desc1 = desc1.replace('\u2014', '\\u2014')
    desc2 = desc2.replace('\u2014', '\\u2014')
    desc3 = desc3.replace('\u2014', '\\u2014')

    result = f'''gallery: gallery-section(
    accent: {accent},
    items: (
      (img: "{img1}", title: "{title1}", copy: "{desc1}"),
      (img: "{img2}", title: "{title2}", copy: "{desc2}"),
      (img: "{img3}", title: "{title3}", copy: "{desc3}"),
    ),
  )'''
    replacements += 1
    return result

new_content = pattern.sub(replacer, content)

if replacements == 0:
    print("ERROR: no gallery-magazine calls matched")
    sys.exit(1)

print(f"Replaced {replacements} gallery-magazine calls")

with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(new_content)
print("Done")
